Pixels with L < 45 are 44.1 % of the box x 200-800, y 40-320. The refix engineer's diagnosis is confirmed: this is the deliberate hound shadow (art/blender/fighters/tunlan.py:170-173, card :179-189, HOUND :1899), not a stray occluder. CW6_verify1 did accept it: line 39 says 'a hound-shaped hand shadow on the plate', and TUN-C3 passed with 'Minor: the shadow floats on the sky plate'. I rate the visible result higher than that minor.
